step0.stderr:
usage: kith echo set permission MODE   (MODE '' forgets this Mac's choice)
       kith echo set call-model MODEL   (MODEL: sonnet, haiku, opus, own for the agent's own model, default to forget)
       kith echo set limit N|none       (a monthly limit in dollars at API prices; none forgets it)
       kith echo set at-limit MODE      (ask, tell or hold: what your own runs do at the limit; ask by default)
       kith echo set harness H [--model M]   (claude, codex, ...: the harness it runs on; drops a model of the old one)
       kith echo set model M|default    (agent.md's model; a Claude model needs a Claude harness; default removes the line)
       kith echo set effort E|default   (low, medium, high, xhigh or max; default removes the line)
       add --json to any of them: one JSON object on stdout; an error is {"ok": false, "error": "..."} on stdout, same exit code
